milestones.en: Set foot on Pongso no Tao
milestones.detailEn: Choose your home and walk into Lanyu.

milestones.en: Put the island's name in your notebook
milestones.detail: 向長輩請教，解鎖第一批族語詞卡。
milestones.detailEn: Ask an elder and unlock your first Tao word cards.

milestones.detail: 在紅頭衛生所記下飛魚與水芋的營養搭配。
milestones.detailEn: At the Imorod health station, note how flying fish and taro work together as food.

milestones.detail: 在教學田裡完成一次水芋採收。
milestones.detailEn: Harvest taro once in the teaching field.

milestones.en: The sea in flying fish season
milestones.detail: 於飛魚季在體驗點完成一次時機互動。
milestones.detailEn: Do the timing activity once at the practice spot during flying fish season.

milestones.en: A view of Little Orchid Island
milestones.detail: 在南岸眺望 Jimagaod，並收入椰子筆記。
milestones.detailEn: Look out at Jimagaod from the south coast and add it to your coconut notes.

milestones.detail: 親身切換清晨、白天、黃昏與夜晚。
milestones.detailEn: See dawn, day, dusk and night for yourself.

milestones.detail: 體驗招魚祭、飛魚季、終食祭與休漁期。
milestones.detailEn: Experience the fish-calling festival, flying fish season, end-of-eating festival and the off-season.
